name: AI chat with tools
summary: A support assistant on Next.js and the AI SDK: it streams answers through the Vercel AI Gateway, looks orders up and opens tickets in Postgres, and emails a copy through Resend, tested against scripted and faulted model answers with no model key.
runsOn: A Next.js app in Chromium, with the model emulated and Postgres in Docker
shows: The app's model played by danwo's emulator: every answer scripted per test, tool calls included, so the tests are exact and need no key
Model faults on cue: three rate limits then an answer, a refusal, a malformed tool call, with `llmScripts`
A matrix over every way a model call fails (429, 5xx, a lost answer, a refusal, an empty or cut-off answer, a content filter, a malformed tool call, a broken stream), Resend errors and the app's SQL
Invariants over Postgres, the Resend emulator and the page: one ticket per request, one email per ticket, tool writes only with valid arguments, the saved conversation the same as the one shown
danwo's agent driving the chat, replayed from its cache with no model calls on the second run
